# About Me

I am Michael Junyan Zeng (曾俊焱) and graduated from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science in July 2022.

Previously, I have worked in Tencent and Meituan. I have experience in Backend Development, LLM Training and Big Data Processing.

## Education

- The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (09/2018 - 07/2022)
  - Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
  - Awarded HKUST Entrance Scholarship (09/2018)

## Industry Experiences

- **Meituan (Beijing)** (08/2022 - Present)
  - Position: Algorithm Engineering Back-end Development
  - Led algorithm engineering projects in supply chain optimization and large-model training.
  - Implemented system monitoring, caching, and circuit-breaking mechanisms for operational efficiency.
- **Tencent (Shenzhen)** (06/2021 - 08/2021)
  - Position: Management System Back-end Development (Intern)
  - Ensured content compliance for network cloud platform audit system.

## Project Experience

- **MoE4xB/5xxB Model Training Efficiency Optimization** (02/2025 - Present)
  - Assisted CUDA kernel developers in implementing the Swiglu FC2 Fuse solution.
  - Utilized custom Torch functions, Expert Parallel, and Cuda Kernel Fuse technologies to optimize the training efficiency of the MoE4xB/5xxB model to reach an MFU of 30%, reducing training time and costs.
- **Multi-Modal Large-Model Training and Deployment** (10/2024 - Present)
  - Based on the pre-trained MoE6B/8xB LLM, supported the voice embedding, encoder, and adaptor structures for the multi-modal large-scale model.
  - Achieved large-scale training on an 1K-card cluster using technologies such as Megatron Tensor Parallel, F1B2 Pipeline Parallel.
  - Successfully launched the model for internal use, promoting its application in various business scenarios.
- **Development and Optimization of Meituan's Text-to-Speech (TTS) Large-scale Model** (04/2024 - 10/2024)
  - Supported the expansion of the TTS model structure from 500M parameters to 1.5B parameters.
  - Utilized the Varlen Attention Llama structure and loss-masked DiT structure for efficient parameter expansion and large-scale model training.
  - Processed the filtering and packaging operations of millions hours of PB level training data, significantly improving the performance of the TTS model.
- **Decision-Making Service Data Acquisition** (12/2022 - 03/2023)
  - Developed SQL-based heterogeneous data joint-query component using Calcite, integrating hive-spark, s3, and non-table data sources.
